tweets.author: thejohnnycrypto.bsky.social
tweets.text:
The structural takeaway:
✅ Treasury companies bridging traditional finance and Bitcoin
✅ Capital market products broadening institutional participation
✅ Bitcoin-backed financing expanding investment pathways
✅ Corporate balance sheets becoming strategic adoption vehicles

tweets.author: thejohnnycrypto.bsky.social
tweets.text: Rather than focusing solely on Bitcoin accumulation, he described treasury companies as vehicles that issue equity and digital credit instruments backed by Bitcoin, letting capital that might otherwise stay in conventional assets participate in the Bitcoin ecosystem.

tweets.author: thejohnnycrypto.bsky.social
tweets.text: He argued that Bitcoin treasury companies are emerging as intermediaries between traditional capital markets and Bitcoin by designing financial products that operate within existing investment frameworks.
